title: The Drainage Test: What Bangkok's September 2026 Floods Reveal About Asset Risk
detail: Bangkok's industrial estates held this time, but 300 mm of local rain exposed the flood that most asset-level models do not measure, while the Chao Phraya is still rising.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
